The Naturpark Hohe Mark , founded in 1963 is one of the biggest Nature Parks in North Rhine-Westphalia , Germany. [ 1 ]
The Naturpark Hohe Mark includes parts of the Lower Rhine Region , south western Münsterland and northern Ruhr Area . The Nature Park reaches from cities like Lüdinghausen in the east to the dutch border near Bocholt in the west. [ 2 ]
